status: PROPOSED module-level source decisions for H1 arm B (2026-10-21 UTC), from a $0 desk audit of primary sources and a $0 local validation of 5 instances per module per difficulty (pinned installs in an isolated scratch environment). Decisions are proposals for the maintainer; adopting any third-party generator is also a dependency decision. Nothing here is downloaded into the repository or generated at scale.
verification_policy: a library score is NEVER the correctness verdict: many scorers give partial credit (near-miss wrong answers scored 0.84-0.999), five reasoning-gym scorers evaluate the answer text as Python (string_insertion, spiral_matrix, binary_matrix, n_queens via eval; countdown via sympy parse_expr), and must never see teacher output

arm B uses a PROJECT-SIDE exact check per module: canonical exact match against the generator's gold, or, where several answers are valid, a project validity checker (simulation, constraint check); score_answer may only be consulted on the generator's own gold during the audit

instances are generated ONCE, with PYTHONHASHSEED and every seed pinned, in a fresh process per module, and STORED as task files; nothing is regenerated later (several modules depend on the hash seed, the global RNG, process history or the wall clock)

reference proofs and solution traces (PrOntoQA chain_of_thought, reasoning-core metadata.cot, string_manipulation states) are used ONLY to verify the teacher's process; they never enter a prompt and never become a target
